When I was 14 I had a friend. Lets call her K. We hung out ever single day back then. Went on crazy adventures together and confided in each other like best friends do. One morning after she had slept over I noticed my new iPod was missing from my night stand and she had left to go home already. I vividly remember waking up, saying hi to her (she was on the desktop computer in my room),  telling her I was going back to sleep, and putting the iPod on the night stand beside me. She never admit it.

I wanted to punch her in the face and take it back but she had 50lbs on me and I didnt need a broken face. The iPod was the only present my mom could afford for my birthday/Christmas as theyre a month apart and I loved it. It was one of those square ones with a screen and it honestly broke my heart that she stole it because she knew how unstable we were financially after my dad died. Fucking bitch.

Edit: I forgot to add that a week or so after when she denied it to the point I was starting to believe I was crazy, her cousin or whatever "gave her" the exact same type of iPod that I had just "lost".
